a wall in the way to the right: the character at column 5 of each of four rows from the attacker's head ($10) checked against the walls ($80F7); one knocks the attacker back (state 9, moving left), sound 19, $8132 set for the computer, and the two pla end the caller's pass.
the character under test, compared with each wall character: the operand of the cmp at $9251, written at $9245.
the same to the left, at column 0.
the character under test, compared with each wall character: the operand of the cmp at $928A, written at $927E.
the guard walking left: a wall in the cell beside it on any of its rows ($20 + $26, a row every 40) knocks it back (state 9, moving right, $8133), sound 19.
the character under test, compared with each wall character: the operand of the cmp at $92BE, written at $92B2.
every 150 frames, with a random number below the defender's level's chance ($8136: 15, 20 or 30 in 256), the dog runs on: from the right going left, or from the left going right, at random.
the attacker's floor ($8BF5: 21 less its y / 8) and the screen address of its rows ($10/$11), for the floor and wall checks.
the attacker's row, y / 8, subtracted to give its floor: the operand of the sbc at $934A, written at $933F.
the same for the guard ($8BF6, $20/$21), the column from its x, kept from 3 to 37.
the guard's row, y / 8, subtracted to give its floor: the operand of the sbc at $9370, written at $9365.
code nothing calls: it would set $8131, which stops the guard's floor checks.

a ladder's foot (character $10) in the six cells of the row below the attacker's head ($10 + $28 to $2D): the climb starts (state 5, $8BF7 = 1), first sidling until the ladder is at $10 + $2B; the two pla end the caller's pass.
a step up the ladder ($8E5D does it); at floor 11, the walkway, the attacker stands there ($810E stops it starting down again at once).
a step down; at floor 0, the ground, it stands ($8C14).
a ladder's top (character $12) in the six cells at the attacker's feet ($10 + $78 to $7D): the climb down starts (state 5, $8BF7 = $FF).
above the ground, a floor character under the attacker's feet ($80E8) keeps it up; with none it drops (state 6) and the two pla end the caller's pass. On the ground $8C14 is set.
the character under the attacker's feet, compared with each floor character: the operand of the cmp at $949D, written at $9493.
in the air above the ground: a landing character ($80F2) under its feet lets the jump land; otherwise the two pla keep it flying.
the character under the attacker's feet, compared with each landing character: the operand of the cmp at $94CC, written at $94C2.
the same for the guard ($8BF6, $20): it drops (state 6) with nothing under it.
the character under the guard's feet, compared with each floor character: the operand of the cmp at $94EF, written at $94E5.
the guard walking: no floor character just ahead of its feet ($20 + $9D) makes it jump (state 2).
the character ahead of the guard's feet, compared with each floor character: the operand of the cmp at $951D, written at $9513.
the computer's attacker above the ground: no floor character ahead of its feet ($10 + $7D) makes it jump (state 2, straight up).
the character ahead of the attacker's feet, compared with each floor character: the operand of the cmp at $9546, written at $953C.
the guard in the air lands on a landing character.
the character under the guard's feet, compared with each landing character: the operand of the cmp at $9574, written at $956A.

fighter Y on fire, with a guard on and the two on the same floor: with the guard up to 30 pixels to the right of the attacker, a random number below 5 makes the fighter step in (state 1); otherwise sound 30 and the stroke (state 3, timer 5), and the two pla end the caller's pass; with the guard to the left, the two pla end the pass and nothing happens.
the guard's distance from the attacker, for the cmp at $95A2: the operand of the lda at $95A0, written at $9593.
fighter Y throws a knife: sound 20, state 4, one knife fewer ($8115), and the knife flies from its x, 16 lines below its top, the way it faces; the attacker's knives redrawn ($961B).
the attacker's knives left ($8115) at the top left, a knife (characters $FE, $FF) in each of columns 1 to 4.
the guards left ($8135) at the top right, a head of the defender's uniform (characters $F6 + side x 4) every two columns from 37 down.
the flying knives into the sprite list: pointer $DB going right, $DC left, white.
the rolling barrel against the fighters on the ground: within 24 pixels it knocks one over backwards (state 9), sound 15, and blows up ($812E counting 1 to 9 every 3 frames), then is gone.
the barrel's distance from the fighter, low byte, for the cmp at $96DE: the operand of the lda at $96DC, written at $96CF.
the dog against the fighters on the ground, standing or walking: within 24 pixels it knocks one over (state 9), sound 7.
the dog's distance from the fighter, low byte, for the cmp at $976B: the operand of the lda at $9769, written at $975C.
the barrel in the sprite list: picture $B8, then the explosion's ($B9-$C1), red.
the dog in the sprite list, two sprites 24 pixels apart, dark grey: $C8-$CA in front of $CB-$CD going right, $CE-$D0 in front of $D1-$D3 going left, by its frame.
every 5 frames the dog runs 10 pixels its way, the next of its three frames; one time in 25 it barks (sound 29).
while the attacker moves the dog moves the other way by the scroll's speed, so it keeps its place in the fort.
the same for the barrel.

the barrel off the screen is gone.
every 60 tiles the view moves to the right ($812F) a barrel rolls in from the right edge (x $148); going back to the left, at the count's 19th tile one comes in from the left edge (x 8).
the guard off the screen to the left, or past x $15A on the right, is gone.
every 2 frames each flying knife goes 8 pixels its way; off the screen it is gone.
the attacker cannot go back past the fort's start ($810F/$8110): it stands, and the two pla end the caller's pass.
once the time is up the attacker takes state 7 and its orders end.

each flying knife against the other side's fighter, standing, walking, striking, throwing or in a jump before its last crouch, so a duck lets a knife pass: from the fighter's top to 40 lines below it and about 16 to 24 pixels across, it knocks the fighter over (state 9, backwards), sound 28, and is gone.
the knife's distance from the fighter, low byte, for the cmp at $9AA9: the operand of the lda at $9AA7, written at $9A9A.
the defender's orders by its state, through $9B05/$9B0F, while a guard is on.

state 1: a ledge ahead ($9505) or a wall ($92AE) first; then as standing.

states 0 and 1, once its timer is out: whether it drops ($94D7); at x $7F or more it walks left toward the attacker, fighting if it can ($9BAA); left of x $64 it walks on left; in between: if the attacker jumps from the guard's own floor ($8134) the guard knocks him over (sound 6, state 9); it stands and fights when the attacker is on its floor, or climbing, dropping or down; otherwise it walks on left.

a computer guard, the attacker not down and on its floor, the guard to his right, with a random number below $50: with a random number below $64, no knife of its own flying and the attacker 40 pixels or more away it throws ($95D3), and its knife count ($8116) is not checked, so it never runs out; otherwise, after its delay ($9C24), it strikes ($957F). passes the guard waits before it strikes.
